snippet.title: Devlog 3a: New Recipe System
snippet.description:
Not cooking related.

This is a short, less formal feature update while a larger devlog is still being put together. It covers a new feature; a way for you to choose different material combinations when building station modules.

Each star system only contains a small set of the game’s total materials. Recipes let you adapt your builds to what the system provides, decide what to gather, and plan your ship assignments around material scarcity. As the game progresses, you’ll be able to unlock additional recipes for more flexibility.

# About The Game
This is a sci-fi roguelite survival strategy game where you build temporary space stations, manage a persistent fleet, balance interlocking systems like power, heat, and crew madness, and race against an escalating nanotech swarm.

Subscribe to this channel for more development updates!
